cuts.line: And am I playing on this 8-pack's ass? Yes, but they're an 8-pack, and that should literally be illegal.
I do seem to always have an excuse.
I mean what do we do in letting an entire group of eight play together on one hole? Why are we not splitting up four and four? This is ridiculous.
(tee shot) That's not gonna quite do it.
I think I was really focused on the eight men on the green at this current time.
They did actually let me play through, so I was talking shit for nothing.
The part that sucks though is now they're watching me film, and so now I'm really nervous.
